Applies a 4x4 transformation matrix to all vertices and normals of a mesh, typically to move geometry from a local object frame to a world frame or to apply kinematic transforms to robot links [S1, unofficial][S2, unofficial].

The claim states that the process applies a 4x4 transformation matrix to all vertices and normals of a mesh, typically for moving geometry from a local object frame to a world frame or applying kinematic transforms to robot links. Source [S1] explicitly describes the code logic for applying a 4x4 transformation matrix (`xf`) to vertices and normals. Source [S2] describes the context of transforming robot link meshes from the object frame to the world frame using 4x4 transforms. Both sources align with the facts presented in the claim.
